title: Pack and unpack a tar archive of small files
summary: Pack tens to hundreds of small in-memory text files (config, source, locale and data files, 100 bytes to 3 KB each) into one tar archive held in memory, then list and read back every entry.
notes: A synchronous, in-memory task: the archive is built in a buffer and read back from it, never touching the file system. tar-stream, @std/tar and @mary/tar offer only streaming or asynchronous APIs, tar, tar-fs and fastar work on files or compressed streams, and estargz/tgz are other jobs, so they are not part of this task.
